# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_conversational_components (Resource)

The conversational components of a WhatsApp phone number, the ice breakers and commands WhatsApp users see when they open a chat with the business. Creating this resource adopts the components of an existing number; destroying it leaves them as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroy leaves the components as they are.
resource "telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_conversational_components" "support" {
  phone_number = telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number.support.phone_number
  ice_breakers = [
    "Where is my order?",
    "I want to return an item.",
  ]
  commands = [
    { command = "status", description = "Check the status of an order." },
    { command = "agent", description = "Talk to a person." },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `phone_number` (String) The WhatsApp phone number in E.164 format.

### Optional

- `commands` (Attributes List) Commands a WhatsApp user can send by typing `/`, in display order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--commands))
- `ice_breakers` (List of String) Suggested opening messages a WhatsApp user can tap to start a chat, in display order.

### Read-Only

- `record_type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--commands"></a>
### Nested Schema for `commands`

Optional:

- `command` (String) The command, without the leading `/`.
- `description` (String) What the command does, shown to the WhatsApp user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_conversational_components.support <phone_number>
```
